name: Peninsula Gardens | 1.5g Hand Roll | Fun Dip
description:
Zkittlez x Sweet Retreat

More candy from the PG gang. Bred by Fiya Farmer she’s got beautiful purple flower with a sweet exotic pastry smell that translates perfectly into the smoke. You’ll also notice a nice Z backend from the zkittlez. We’re really excited for this one and we know you’ll be too!
